policy: Source distribution boundaries and exact resource identities. Exclusion does not by itself classify every file as restricted. Applicable component licenses and corresponding-source obligations remain in force.

public-workbench.purpose: Reviewed source-only workbench; HybrIK image-pose and GVHMR video-motion new inference are explicitly disabled as experimental, regardless of local environments. Existing assets and all other functions remain available under their own dependencies/licenses.

release_marker.experimental_message: 实验性，后续会更新与HybrIK以及GVHMR的兼容包

public-workbench.boundary_caveat: Included configuration and JSON/NPZ clients do not relicense external implementations or models. Their applicable use, combination and redistribution terms remain independent.
public-workbench.licenses: Root compatible combination GPLv3, preserved existing or-later rights; first-party original Apache-2.0 option; nested GPL/MIT/Apache/BSD/OFL apply by file, not a blanket MIT grant.

standalone-detector.purpose: Source-only AGPL detector profile, applicable only when detector source is supplied; no model weights or installed dependencies.
standalone-detector.licenses: New detector CLI AGPL-3.0-only; upstream Ultralytics 8.2.42 AGPL, weights separate. Process boundaries do not waive obligations.

local-research.purpose: Classification of research implementations, environments and user data excluded from source publication; building this profile is disabled.
local-research.licenses: GVHMR custom research/non-profit and nested rights; HybrIK MIT portions do not cover MPG/SMPL/SMPL-X programs/models; per-artifact terms apply.

binary_policy: Only exact paths and SHA256 values explicitly approved in docs/resource-license-evidence.json. No model checkpoint/environment/binary fallback and no recursive workspace copying.

gpl_selection.skintokens_michelangelo: GPL version 3 selected for compliance; file-level later option not established, no existing later rights narrowed
gpl_selection.directory_external_derivation: third_party/SkinTokens/src/model/skin_vae/autoencoders/miche_transformer_blocks.py; GPL-derived plus preserved MIT checkpoint material

history_policy: Every reachable commit and ref must satisfy the selected publication profile; a source artifact check does not replace history inspection.
installation_scope: Source artifacts exclude installed environments, credentials, caches, gated downloads, model weights and user data.
